performance.verdict: Meta fully dark 10+ days; 5 overdue SOW milestones threaten renewal.

findings.text: Meta spend hit $0 on Sep 14 and has stayed at $0 for 10+ consecutive days, making last-7d spend -100% and leads null — campaigns are fully paused.
5 SOW milestones are overdue (oldest: Jul 23 renewal docs, newest: Aug 31 dashboard + renewal decision) — all unresolved as of Sep 26.
GHL shows 49 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — 40 Meta leads over 28 days are not converting through intake pipeline.
3-day signal (Sep 23–25): spend $0, leads 0, ig_reach avg ~0.3 vs prior 3 days (Sep 20–22) also near zero — dark channel is entrenched, not a single bad day.
GA4 sessions held at 7–13/day in the dark period (Sep 20–25) while search clicks dropped -36% — organic/direct holding but no paid support.

suggestions.text: Reactivate Meta campaigns immediately; prior CPL was $10.90 on 40 leads — every dark day burns renewal credibility.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 since Sep 14, confirmed across 10+ consecutive days in the series — campaigns must be reactivated today. Prior 28-day performance was $10.90 CPL across 40 leads at $435.88 spend, which is the efficiency baseline to protect. Success check: spend resumes within 24 hours and CPL returns to ≤$12 by Sep 30. Sohib to confirm with client whether pause was intentional before reactivating.

suggestions.text: Resolve intake leak: 49 GHL opportunities, 0 appointments — fix CRM-to-booking hand-off before scaling any spend.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 49 opportunities created and $0 won with 0 appointments booked in the 28-day window — this is an intake hand-off failure, not an ads problem. Ahmed/Ali to audit the opportunity pipeline and identify where leads are stalling (no follow-up trigger, booking link broken, or Flex Dental sync gap). Success check: at least 5 appointments logged in GHL within 7 days of fix. Re-check Oct 3.

suggestions.text: Watch all 5 overdue SOW milestones; Aug 31 dashboard and renewal decision are unresolved — client walk risk is live.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones remain unresolved as of Sep 26, the oldest dating to Jul 23 (renewal closed) and two from Aug 31 (dashboard live; renewal decision). The client's own scoreboard — leads → scheduled → showed → new patient → revenue — cannot be trusted without the dashboard, and the Aug 31 stay/walk decision has no confirmed resolution. Sohib to confirm status of each milestone with Nacer and client by Sep 29. Re-check Sep 30.
